node: Regulated niche API suppliers with customer re-validation lock-in
summary: Expanded the US-listed universe for regulated niche API suppliers. The cleanest underfollowed direct exposure found in this pass is Amphastar, because it explicitly manufactures a narrow set of APIs in cGMP/FDA-compliant facilities and is small-cap. Amneal and Dr. Reddy's add mid-cap/ADR exposure to vertically integrated API manufacturing and global DMF/regulatory filings, but their API exposure is less pure because broader generics/formulations dominate the investor narrative. Teva/TAPI is included only as a reference leader because its API portfolio is large and obvious, not underfollowed.
